data.name: Lysandre
data.gender_notes: Lysandre is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'lysos' meaning 'loose' or 'free', and 'andros' meaning 'man'. Lysandre signifies a liberator or free man in ancient Greek culture. The name Lysandre carries the meaning “Liberator, Free Man” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Lysandre usually hope their child will grow to embody liberator, free man and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Lysandre belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Liberator, Free Man.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Lysandre total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_hebrew.name: ליסנדר
in_hebrew.meaning: ליסנדר משמעותו משחרר העם או משחרר האנשים
in_hebrew.long_meaning: ליסנדר הוא שם שמקורו ביוונית ומשמעותו 'משחרר העם' או 'משחרר האנשים'. השם ליסנדר הוא תרגום של השם היווני Λυσάνδρος (Lysandros), שפירושו 'משחרר'. השם נמצא בשימוש בקרב הנוצרים והוא קשור לערכים של שחרור וגאולה.

in_greek.name: Λυσάνδρος
in_greek.long_meaning: Ο Λυσάνδρος είναι ένα όνομα που προέρχεται από την ελληνική γλώσσα και σημαίνει 'απελευθερωτής του λαού' ή 'απελευθερωτής των ανθρώπων'. Το όνομα αυτό ήταν κοινό στην αρχαία Ελλάδα και συνδέεται με την έννοια της ελευθερίας και της απελευθέρωσης. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, παρόλο που δεν αναφέρεται άμεσα, ο όρος 'λύσις' (lysis) που σημαίνει 'ελευθέρωση' ή 'απελευθέρωση' είναι σημαντικός.

in_latin.name: Lysander
in_latin.long_meaning: Lysander, a name derived from Greek origins, signifies 'liberator of the people'. The name was popularized in ancient Greece and carried significant meaning related to freedom and release. Early Christian traditions adopted various names with similar connotations, reflecting their values of spiritual liberation.

in_english.name: Lysandre
in_english.meaning: Liberator of the people or free man
in_english.long_meaning: The name Lysandre originates from the Greek name Λυσάνδρος (Lysandros), meaning 'liberator of the people'. It is derived from the Greek words 'lysis', meaning 'release' or 'liberation', and 'andros', meaning 'man'. While not directly mentioned in the Bible, the concept of liberation is central to Christian theology, particularly in the context of spiritual freedom from sin. Historically, the name has been associated with positive attributes such as leadership and freedom.

data.cultural_impact: In the Christian context, the name Lysandre takes on a spiritualizing influence drawing from both its Greek origins and biblical themes. Given its ancient Greek meaning of a liberator, the name can be seen as a reflection of God's freeing power in the lives of believers. This is a reminder of God's redemptive work in the world and the liberation of humanity from sin and death through the life, death, and resurrection of Jesus Christ.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, Lysandre holds a special significance for Christians as a reminder of the ultimate liberator, Jesus Christ. The name reflects the freedom and redemption that comes from following Christ and living a life rooted in faith. It can serve as a reminder of the importance of trusting in God's saving power and the assurance of a life free from the bondage of sin and worldly desires. Through the name Lysandre, Christians are encouraged to live courageously and freely, trusting in God's guidance and protection.
